description: Juicing chamber leaked moonberry juice onto the lab floor; Nimbus resealing it
body: The juicing chamber leaked a litre of juice across the lab floor. Nimbus is resealing it with food-grade wax this week.

description: 1:1 with Quibblesworth: I'll present Moonbeam at the September board demo
body: Quibblesworth asked me to present Project Moonbeam to the board at the demo in early September. We talked about what a promotion case would need: a working prototype and a happy board.
